metadata.question: Were there more fire events detected with the VIIRS sensors in the southern Brazilian Amazon in 2020 than in 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use FIRMS/VIIRS fire detection data (FIRMS or MODIS/VIIRS collections) - GEE has "FIRMS: Fire Information for Resource Management System" dataset - Collection: 'FIRMS' with VIIRS sensor data - Actually, the correct dataset is likely "MODIS/006/MOD14A1" or VIIRS-specific - Let me use: "NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGML" - VIIRS Active Fire product - Date: 2019 vs 2020 (full years) - Location: Southern Brazilian Amazon (approximate region: -15 to -5 lat, -75 to -45 lon) 2. Masking strategy: - Fire detection data doesn't need cloud masking - Filter by confidence if available - Count fire detections (pixels or points) 3. Logic to distinguish: - Valid Zero: If collection exists but count is 0, that's a valid answer (B if 2020≤2019) - C1: No data available in either year - C2: Not applicable for point data - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - A: 2020 > 2019 - B: 2020 ≤ 2019 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define southern Brazilian Amazon region const southernAmazon = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-75, -15, -45, -5]); // 2. Load VIIRS active fire data const viirs2019 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGML') .filterDate('2019-01-01', '2019-12-31') .filterBounds(southernAmazon); const viirs2020 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGML') .filterDate('2020-01-01', '2020-12-31') .filterBounds(southernAmazon); // 3. Check collection sizes const size2019 = viirs2019.size().getInfo(); const size2020 = viirs2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images: ${size2019}`); console.log(`2020 Images: ${size2020}`); if (size2019 === 0 && size2020 === 0) { console.log('No VIIRS data found for either year.'); console.log('C1'); return; } if (size2019 === 0 || size2020 === 0) { console.log('Missing data for one year.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Count fire detections (each detection is a feature) const count2019 = viirs2019.filterBounds(southernAmazon).size().getInfo(); const count2020 = viirs2020.filterBounds(southernAmazon).size().getInfo(); // 5. For more accurate counts, sum all fire pixels across all images const fireCount2019 = viirs2019.map(function(img) { return img.select('Bright_ti4').unmask(0); }).sum().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: southernAmazon, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Bright_ti4'); const fireCount2020 = viirs2020.map(function(img) { return img.select('Bright_ti4').unmask(0); }).sum().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: southernAmazon, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Bright_ti4'); const fires2019 = fireCount2019.getInfo(); const fires2020 = fireCount2020.getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Fire Pixels: ${fires2019}`); console.log(`2020 Fire Pixels: ${fires2020}`); // 6. Validation if (fires2019 === null || fires2020 === null) { console.log('Calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (fires2019 === 0 && fires2020 === 0) { console.log('No fire pixels detected in either year.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 7. Final answer console.log(`Comparison: 2020 (${fires2020}) vs 2019 (${fires2019})`); if (fires2020 > fires2019) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
